reports.name: Yrxy2
reports.evidence: Catalogue of Gene Symbols for Wheat 2012 Supplement {10829}
reports.note: High temperature resistance; Xiaoyan 54; Xwmc794-2AS – 4.0 cM – Yrxy2 – 6.4 cM – Xbarc5-2AL.Read from the Catalogue of Gene Symbols for Wheat 2012 Supplement, Nov 2026 (ad56.py). In-silico PCR of the BARC5 primer pair (USDA-ARS BARC list) on RefSeq v1.0: product 284 bp at 2A 674,475,917-674,476,201 bp; primers matched by their 3' 15 bases (2 and 3 mismatches over the full primers, mostly in the 5' GCG tail that BARC primers carry). Marker sequence found and mapped in silico, Nov 2026 (ad69.py).
